title: Miniscript behind a timelock or one hash check

schema.around: sane miniscript, or a lone OP_TRUE
schema.also: a lone uncompressed key behind those checks, in P2SH only

note: Knots #481 names the forms miniscript-timelock, miniscript-hash, miniscript-timelock-hash, and anyone-after-checks. The leaf inside an Ark hop is this class. WLS-1 does not use it: the same shape is also JoinMarket and Boltz, and those must not be inserted as an Ark package. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.
